title: From the House of the Dead
match: From the House of the Dead

facts.text: It was the composer's last opera, premiered on 12 April 1930 at the National Theatre Brno, two years after his death.
facts.attribution: Wikipedia, “From the House of the Dead”
facts.evidence: It was the composer's last opera, premiered on 12 April 1930 at the National Theatre Brno, two years after his death.

facts.text: The libretto was translated and adapted by the composer from the 1862 novel by Fyodor Dostoevsky.
